title: Oral semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in high-risk type 2 diabetes
authors: McGuire DK, Marx N, Mulvagh SL, Deanfield JE, Inzucchi SE, Pop-Busui R, et al.
population: Adults aged 50 or over with type 2 diabetes, HbA1c 6.5 to 10.0% and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease or both
funder: Funded by Novo Nordisk, as stated in the abstract; the sponsor's role was not read.
result: Major adverse cardiovascular events occurred in 579 of 4825 (12.0%; 3.1 per 100 person-years) on oral semaglutide up to 14 mg daily against 668 of 4825 (13.8%; 3.7 per 100 person-years) on placebo (hazard ratio 0.86, 95% CI 0.77 to 0.96). Confirmatory secondary outcomes, including major kidney disease events, did not differ significantly. Serious adverse events 47.9% against 50.3%; gastrointestinal disorders 5.0% against 4.4%.
